Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons oakland ca, dance lessons oakland ca, salsa lessons oakland ca and wedding dance lessons oakland ca). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. details.html:
0 of 12STUDIOS EARN AN A
FOR AI READINESS

Twelve studios compete for Oakland's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 12 dance and ballroom studios serving the Oakland market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 54 to 96. The AI engines name only four of the 12. The field averages 58 (D) on AI readiness, 12 of 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 of 12 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 14 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Oakland, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 12 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Walnut Creek (96) and Tip Top Ballroom (85) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 54. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 58 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 12 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • One of the 12 is a franchise location (one Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #12 is 42 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Oakland.” Studios that serve Oakland from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

The monthly SEO / AEO program

WhenFocusWhat happens
Month 1Fix what's broken; claim the open leverFAQ/Q&A schema, llms.txt, missing alt text and meta descriptions, thin pages, correct schema typing.
Month 2-3Broaden content to match how buyers askContent built around both the specialist and the generic query, and around the city buyers actually search.
OngoingOff-site signal buildingReviews, directory consistency, third-party mentions.
Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (12 studios): arthurmurraylive.com/walnut-creek, tiptopballroom.com, allegroballroom.com, breakawayswing.com, mystiqueballroom.com, sizzlinglatin.com, rhythmandflo.com, stepsontoes.com, hiddencityballroom.com, salsamaniaproductions.com, justdanceballroom.com, inlakechdance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 14 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Oakland dance searches. The Bay Area is split into five pages: San Francisco, Oakland (East Bay), San Jose (South Bay), Fremont (south Alameda County and the Tri-Valley) and San Mateo (the Peninsula). Sizzling Latin teaches in Oakland, Emeryville and Dublin from one website and is ranked here. Allegro and Hidden City are in Richmond; Tip Top, Mystique, Rhythm N Flo and Arthur Murray are in Walnut Creek. Left out: Trilliant Studios (its site fails to open a secure connection), private instructors (Wedding & Salsa Dance with Lucy, Jasmine Worrell, Erin Parsley, Vanessa Thomson, Karen and Michael, Johanna Michelle, Salsa with Tomaj), venues and event spaces (Oakstop, Lake Merritt Dance, Rossmoor Event Center, Zanzi), Latin Connection Dance (now based in the Northwest), hip-hop, youth, pole and contemporary studios that lead the broad answers (In the Groove, Full Out, BlackBox, Danspace, Hipline, Shawl-Anderson, East Bay Dance Center, Oakland Pole + Dance), Dance Fusion's youth company, and Slow Fox Dance Hall in Napa (outside this area).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 14 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Arthur Murray) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Oakland, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Oakland, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 14 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons oakland ca”; “dance lessons oakland ca”; “salsa lessons oakland ca”; “wedding dance lessons oakland ca”; “ballroom dance lessons walnut creek ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in oakland ca” and “ballroom dance studio oakland”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
